data.long_meaning: In Persian culture, the name Atoosa is derived from the Persian word ‘atoseh’ meaning ‘decorated’ or ‘precious’. It is a beautiful name for a girl, evoking images of grace and elegance. The name Atoosa carries the meaning “Decorated, Precious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Atoosa usually hope their child will grow to embody decorated, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
